title: Settlement and Governance Behind the AI Frontier
summary_en: Although there is much focus on cutting-edge AI models from frontier labs, the author argues that open-weight models, agents, and AI uses “behind the frontier” are also dangerous and their governance demands different concepts and tools.
title_cn: Settlement and Governance Behind the AI Frontier

title: Evaluation of Texas’s Student Success Acceleration Program 2.0: Implementation, Early Outcomes, and Lessons for Continuous Improvement
summary_en: RAND’s evaluation of 33 Texas student success programs found positive student experiences and promising early academic associations, with lessons for strengthening implementation and sustainability.
title_cn: Evaluation of Texas’s Student Success Acceleration Program 2.0: Implementation, Early Outcomes, and Lessons for Continuous Improvement
